runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; includeSkills cleared; one scout worker; completed transcript retrieved with history:// after structured result delivery.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only probe with task, hub, and read access; no project writes

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-transcript Skill.
Exactly one read-only TranscriptWorker task was started.
The root collected the worker's structured result containing transcript-ok.
After the worker completed, the root read history://TranscriptWorker.
The history resource contained the user and assistant turns, tool trace, and ordinary assistant marker separately from agent://TranscriptWorker and the delivered structured result.
The transcript contained the complete worker assignment and acceptance contract.
The transcript recorded a successful read of assets/worker.txt.
The ordinary assistant portion of the transcript contained TRANSCRIPT_MARKER=transcript-ok before yield.
The root read only the Skill and root marker; worker.txt was read by TranscriptWorker.
The root read assets/root.txt before delegation and again after transcript retrieval, observing transcript-root-ok both times.
The disposable probe repository remained clean after the run.

limitations: OMP structured yield payloads are collapsed in history:// output, so the fixture requires an ordinary assistant marker before yield and verifies both records independently.
This proves native completed-worker transcript retrieval, not panel coordination or a cancellation race with a delivered late stale payload.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
